key_insight: Two-level overlapping Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW and RGDSW coarse spaces remain scalable for high-order 2D FEM/VEM Poisson problems, with RGDSW cutting coarse-space size substantially while preserving robustness.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical preconditioning strategy for high-order finite element and virtual element solvers where iteration stability and coarse-solver cost strongly affect performance.
method: Develop two-level overlapping additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW and reduced GDSW coarse spaces.
Analyze condition-number bounds for conforming P_k and Q_k discretizations with explicit polynomial-degree dependence.
Test on structured triangular/quadrilateral FEM meshes and polygonal VEM meshes.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments up to polynomial degree k=9 show scalable behavior, and RGDSW reduces coarse problem dimension by about a factor of three while keeping competitive iteration counts.
watch_item: The reported robustness is for the 2D Poisson problem, so performance may differ for more complex PDEs, 3D geometries, or strongly heterogeneous coefficients.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 2D
